parsed.why: No in-state facility ban or documented anti-trans violence, and gender-identity hate-crime coverage gives recourse; against that, custody care cut with no taper, minor-care ban and surgical document rules.

Statewide restroom/locker restriction in state-owned schools and colleges, birth-certificate marker change barred, no state gender-identity hate-crime or discrimination coverage: universal facility exposure without working remedy.

Mob attack met with charges against the victims, no attacker arrests, hospital care denial and male-facility custody/search despite female ID; no gender-identity hate-crime or discrimination law; severe municipal restroom ordinance.

Criminal plus private-bounty bathroom law covering publicly owned buildings including airports, with licence invalidations; Do Not Travel tier, suit unresolved. Resident gender-identity protections are climate only, not an offset.

Only law criminalising restroom use in private businesses too — gas stations, restaurants, hospitals — up to a year's jail for a first offence, litigation pending; broadest inescapable traveller exposure, birth-certificate change barred.
